{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_5","type":"command_execution","command":"/bin/bash -lc \"sed -n '1,220p' src/get-css-location-from-node.ts\"","aggregated_output":"import { ChildNode, Declaration } from 'postcss';\nimport { ProblemLocation } from '@hint/utils-types';\n\ntype Position = {\n    column: number;\n    line: number;\n}\n\nexport type CSSLocationOptions = {\n    isValue?: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Set the start and end position for a property value.\n */\nconst setValuePosition = (node: Declaration, start: Position, end: Position) => {\n    const betweenSplit = node.raws.between ? node.raws.between.split('\\n') : [''];\n\n    end.line = start.line + betweenSplit.length - 1;\n    end.column = betweenSplit.length === 1 ?\n        // The value is in the same line as the property.\n        start.column + node.prop.length + betweenSplit[0].length + node.value.length :\n        /*\n         * The value is in a different line we need to add one\n         * because the position we are looking for is charecter after the end of the value\n         * e.g.\n         *     value;\n         *          ^\n         */\n        betweenSplit[betweenSplit.length - 1].length + node.value.length + 1;\n\n    start.line = end.line;\n    start.column = end.column - node.value.length;\n};\n\n/**\n * Returns the location of a CSS node.\n * @param node postcss Node.\n * @param isValue Indicates if we need the location of the property value.\n */\nexport const getCSSLocationFromNode = (node: ChildNode, options: CSSLocationOptions = {}): ProblemLocation | undefined => {\n    if (!node.source || !node.source.start) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n\n    // Clone `source.start` to not modify the original value.\n    const start = { ...node.source.start };\n    const end = {\n        column: start.column,\n        line: start.line\n    };\n\n    if (node.type === 'decl') {\n        if (options.isValue) {\n            setValuePosition(node, start, end);\n        } else {\n            end.line = start.line;\n            end.column = start.column + node.prop.length;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return {\n        column: start.column - 1,\n        endColumn: end.column - 1,\n        endLine: end.line - 1,\n        line: start.line - 1\n    };\n};\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_6","type":"command_execution","command":"/bin/bash -lc \"sed -n '1,220p' src/get-css-code-snippet.ts\"","aggregated_output":"import { ChildNode } from 'postcss';\n\nconst getNodeCodeSnippet = (node: ChildNode): string => {\n    switch (node.type) {\n        case 'rule':\n            return `${node.selector.split(/,\\s*/).join(`,\\n`)}`;\n        case 'decl':\n            return `${node.prop}: ${node.value}`;\n        case 'atrule':\n            return `@${node.name} ${node.params}`;\n        case 'comment':\n            return `/* ${node.text} */`;\n        default:\n            return '';\n    }\n};\n\n/**\n * Generate a Snippet code for a CSS node.\n *\n * Examples:\n *\n * Node type `rule`:\n *\n *     .selector { }\n *\n * Node type `decl`\n *\n *     .selector {\n *         prop: value;\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `comment`\n *\n *      /* comment * / (the space is intentional to not break the comment)\n *\n * Node type `atrule`\n *\n *     @keyframe name { }\n *\n * Node type `rule` inside `atrule`\n *\n *     @support (display: grid) {\n *         .selector { }\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `decl` inside `atrule`\n *\n *     @support (display: grid) {\n *         .selector {\n *             prop: value;\n *         }\n *     }\n * @param node - Node to generate the snippet code\n */\nexport const getCSSCodeSnippet = (node: ChildNode): string => {\n    const hasChildren = 'nodes' in node && node.nodes && node.nodes.length;\n    const defaultSuffix = node.type === 'comment' ? '' : ';';\n    const suffix = hasChildren ? ' { }' : defaultSuffix;\n\n    let result = `${getNodeCodeSnippet(node)}${suffix}`;\n    let parent = node.parent;\n\n    while (parent && parent.type !== 'root') {\n        // Indent all child content by four spaces.\n        const content = result.replace(/^/gm, '    ');\n\n        result = `${getNodeCodeSnippet(parent)} {\\n${content}\\n}`;\n        parent = parent.parent;\n    }\n\n    return result;\n};\n\nconst getChildrenCodeSnippet = (children: ChildNode[]): string => {\n    let result = '';\n\n    for (const child of children) {\n        if ('nodes' in child && child.nodes && child.nodes.length) {\n            result += `${getNodeCodeSnippet(child)} {\n${getChildrenCodeSnippet(child.nodes).replace(/^/gm, '    ')}\n}`;\n        } else {\n            result += `${getNodeCodeSnippet(child)}${child.type === 'comment' ? '' : ';'}\\n`;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return result.trim();\n};\n\n/**\n * Generate a Snippet code for a CSS node.\n *\n * Examples:\n *\n * Node type `rule`:\n *\n *     .selector {\n *         prop1: value;\n *         prop2: value;\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `decl`\n *\n *     .selector {\n *         prop1: value;\n *         prop2: value;\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `comment`\n *\n *      /* comment * / (the space is intentional to not break the comment)\n *\n * Node type `atrule`\n *\n *     @keyframe name {\n *         %0 {\n *             prop1: value;\n *             prop2: value;\n *         }\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `rule` inside `atrule`\n *\n *     @support (display: grid) {\n *         .selector {\n *             prop1: value;\n *             prop2: value;\n *         }\n *     }\n *\n * Node type `decl` inside `atrule`\n *\n *     @support (display: grid) {\n *         .selector {\n *             prop: value;\n *             prop: value;\n *         }\n *     }\n * @param node - Node to generate the snippet code\n */\nexport const getFullCSSCodeSnippet = (node: ChildNode): string => {\n    const children = 'nodes' in node && node.nodes;\n    const defaultSuffix = node.type === 'comment' ? '' : ';';\n\n    let result: string;\n    let parent = node.parent;\n\n    if (parent && parent.type !== 'root') {\n        const children = parent.nodes!;\n        const content = getChildrenCodeSnippet(children);\n\n        result = content;\n    } else if (children) {\n        result = `${getNodeCodeSnippet(node)} {\n${getChildrenCodeSnippet(children).replace(/^/gm, '    ')}\n}`;\n    } else {\n        result = `${getNodeCodeSnippet(node)}${defaultSuffix}`;\n    }\n\n    while (parent && parent.type !== 'root') {\n        // Indent all child content by four spaces.\n        const content = result.trim().replace(/^/gm, '    ');\n\n        result = `${getNodeCodeSnippet(parent)} {\\n${content}\\n}`;\n        parent = parent.parent;\n    }\n\n    return result;\n};\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
